Bloom filter API and sizing helpers for insert and membership tests.

# Purpose
Defines the public interface for a Bloom filter stored in shared memory. The file declares the `fd_bloom_t` structure, alignment and footprint constants, and the `FD_BLOOM_MAGIC` value used to validate the object state. It also declares functions to create, join, initialize, insert keys into, and query the filter with [`fd_bloom_new`](<#fd_bloom_new>), [`fd_bloom_join`](<#fd_bloom_join>), [`fd_bloom_initialize`](<#fd_bloom_initialize>), [`fd_bloom_insert`](<#fd_bloom_insert>), and [`fd_bloom_contains`](<#fd_bloom_contains>). The inline helpers [`fd_bloom_max_items`](<#fd_bloom_max_items>) and [`fd_bloom_num_bits`](<#fd_bloom_num_bits>) compute Bloom filter sizing values from the expected item count and false positive rate.
